title: Organization structure
description: Build each company's structure with three forms: levels, then units, then job titles.
selectUnit: Select a unit in the tree to see its details.

empty.title: This company has no units yet
empty.description: Start by adding the first unit at the top level. You can review the levels (sector, department, section, unit) first with the “Levels” button.

levels.title: Levels of the structure
levels.description: Order the levels from top to bottom. The last level accepts job titles and employees.
levels.rules: Enter both names for every level; the last level must accept employees.

impact.title: This change affects existing data
impact.description: Review what will be removed before confirming. Nothing changes until you confirm.
impact.summary: Will be removed: {{units}} unit(s) and {{titles}} job title(s). Employees attached: {{employees}}.
impact.employeesQuestion: What happens to the attached employees ({{count}})?
impact.deleteWarning: {{count}} employees will be deleted, their accounts disabled and their sessions ended.
impact.typeCount: Type the number of employees to confirm

node.title: Add unit
node.description: Choose the level, then the parent unit from the level above.
node.managerHint: Optional. Proposed as the direct manager of the unit's employees.

titles.title: Add job titles
titles.description: Add one or more titles to a unit that accepts employees.

move.title: Move unit
move.description: Choose another unit from the level above this one.

details.deleteBody: The unit and its job titles are deleted if it has no sub-units or employees.
details.deleteTitleBody: A title with employees, or the last title of a unit, cannot be deleted.

chart.searchPlaceholder: Find a unit in the chart
chart.label: Organization chart of {{company}}

table.title: Units ({{count}})
table.name: Unit
table.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, path or manager
